gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro reads dense and tall through the middle of each word, yet its letters open generously inside. Give Wallpoet plenty of size and only a few words.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-multani: Bold Wallpoet curves smoothly with paper showing through its lines, while Noto Sans Multani stands lofty with a wide-mouthed e. Heavy drama up top, quiet openness underneath it all.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Wallpoet lets paper show through the lines between its letters. Noto Sans Myanmar counters with a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle and a broad, welcoming c opening.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Loud meets tight: bold, smooth-curved Wallpoet sits over Noto Sans Old Italic, where capitals barely top the x-height. And made small, Wallpoet would lose the paper showing between its letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Wallpoet is heavy and commanding, smooth around every bend. It earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans Old Persian opens its counters and lofty lowercase into white space.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-sc: Bold Wallpoet lets paper show between its letters, while Noto Sans SC draws chalky curves that stop short of closing. One commands attention, the other keeps its ascenders low.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syriac-west: Wallpoet hits hard, with high-rising lowercase and smooth bends. Noto Sans Syriac Western keeps terminals far from the stroke, so text runs like tightly bundled cable down the page.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Big, bold, unmistakable: Wallpoet rises high and smooth, while Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps its ascenders short and x-height tall. Command in the heading, an approachable manner in the body.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Wallpoet is all weight and smooth bends. Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, its terminals stopping far from the stem, so the heading's drama meets text that already feels large.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Loud meets open: Wallpoet bends smooth and bold, with paper showing between its letters. But Noto Sans Vithkuqi handles the quiet part, with open-throated letters and little step from capitals to lowercase.
